What a bite does

Rapid paralysis and coagulopathy; historically among the fastest-acting Australian elapid venoms untreated.

Antivenom source. Australia.

If you are bitten

Get to a hospital that holds antivenom. Keep still, remove rings and watches, and do not cut, suck or tie off the bite. Use the red “Bitten?” button at the top of any page.
